dedupe_keys.name: flood inundation series of 10 event data sets

description: Flood Inundation (series of 10 event data sets) is a series of data sets listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by IGAD_DRM. This dataset is the output from the Global Flood Model intercomparison project undertaken on behalf of the Global Flood Partnership. The methodology is described in Trigg et al., 2016, "The credibility challenge for global fluvial flood risk analysis," published in the Environmental Research Letters Journal. Coverage: Burundi, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Sudan and 4 more. The portal lists 10 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD_DRM. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
